data.long_meaning: Sumesh means 'good', 'auspicious', 'fortunate'. It is a name of Lord Shiva and a symbol of positivity and good luck. The name Sumesh carries the meaning “Good, Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sumesh usually hope their child will grow to embody good, auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
